summary: Concrete example patterns for translating repeated timing testimony into plain life-event categories without promising a fixed outcome.
body: Use these examples as interpretive labels when natal promise, progressions, returns, activated house rulers, and transits repeat the same theme. A single transit can describe pressure, mood, or opportunity; it should not be promoted into a concrete event unless other timing layers agree.
definition: A predictive example pattern is a cluster of repeated indicators that points toward a life area becoming active enough to describe in plain language, such as relationship definition, career consequence, home movement, health maintenance, legal process, travel logistics, financial restructuring, or public visibility.
appUsage: Surface these examples as possibilities, not verdicts.
Require repeated testimony before naming a concrete event category.
Prefer plain language: relationship definition, career pressure, home change, health maintenance, financial responsibility, legal paperwork, travel logistics, public visibility.
When the topic is sensitive, name the life area and recommend practical support rather than dramatizing the symbol.
Use planet examples to clarify the flavor of the event, and house examples to clarify the life area.
note: Distilled from approved predictive, transit, spiritual astrology, and Saturn cycle reference material. Source files were not copied into the repository.

timingPrinciples.innerAndOuter: Slow planets describe the larger life phase. Faster planets can time the moment when the larger phase becomes visible through a conversation, decision, message, appointment, meeting, conflict, or public announcement.
timingPrinciples.threePassTransit: When a slow planet makes three contacts, read the first pass as the issue appearing, the retrograde pass as review or complication, and the final pass as decision, integration, or consequence.
timingPrinciples.storedActivation: A station, close outer-planet contact, return chart angle, or progressed contact can store pressure. A later fast trigger may coincide with the visible event.
timingPrinciples.eventDefinition: An event can be external, internal, relational, bodily, legal, financial, or psychological. The app should not assume that a transit must produce an obvious outer incident.
timingPrinciples.multipleIndicators: For a major event label, look for the same planet pair, house topic, ruler, angle, or return-chart emphasis repeating at least three times.

sun.plainFocus: Visibility, identity, vitality, leaders, authority figures, recognition, central decisions, and personal direction.
examples: A public role, title, or reputation question comes into focus.
A leader, parent, manager, or authority figure becomes part of the story.
A decision about direction, confidence, or personal visibility can no longer stay vague.

moon.plainFocus: Home, family, emotional safety, body rhythms, care, movement, memory, and the immediate lived environment.
examples: A home, family, caregiving, or domestic matter needs attention.
The body or emotional system responds before the mind has a full explanation.
A short-term timing trigger brings a larger pattern into the day-to-day.

mercury.plainFocus: Messages, paperwork, travel logistics, siblings, study, schedules, devices, agreements, and news.
examples: A document, text, call, email, application, contract, or announcement becomes the trigger point.
Travel, commuting, school, scheduling, or device issues need practical handling.
The event becomes known through a message, meeting, report, or conversation.

venus.plainFocus: Relationships, money, ease, pleasure, value, aesthetics, gifts, social repair, and attraction.
examples: A relationship softens, defines itself, asks for repair, or reveals the true state of affection.
A financial offer, purchase, gift, payment, pricing issue, or spending pattern becomes visible.
A choice about comfort, beauty, desire, or worth carries more weight than usual.

mars.plainFocus: Action, urgency, conflict, heat, inflammation, effort, competition, enterprise, tools, and accidents caused by haste.
examples: A dispute, deadline, confrontation, repair, athletic push, or risky action forces movement.
The body needs caution around speed, inflammation, sharp tools, machinery, driving, or overexertion.
A business launch, bold ask, or competitive effort can move quickly if the aim is clean.

jupiter.plainFocus: Growth, protection, opportunity, teachers, law, publishing, travel, education, faith, and social support.
examples: A legal, academic, publishing, travel, teaching, or certification matter expands.
Support can come through mentors, allies, institutions, or a door opening at the right time.
A joyful life event can become more likely when relationship, family, or 5th-house testimony agrees.

saturn.plainFocus: Time, limits, duty, authority, work, age, health maintenance, delay, structure, accountability, and consequence.
examples: A job, commitment, debt, family duty, legal responsibility, or long-term obligation has to be handled seriously.
The body may ask for maintenance, pacing, treatment, rest, or a more realistic workload.
An authority figure, institution, boss, parent, mentor, or inner critic becomes part of the test.

uranus.plainFocus: Disruption, freedom, shock, innovation, breaks in routine, technology, nervous-system charge, and sudden reversals.
examples: A sudden change, cancellation, breakthrough, relocation impulse, technical disruption, or independence issue changes the plan.
The user may need more freedom or flexibility than the current structure allows.
If accident signatures repeat elsewhere, haste and electrical or mechanical risks deserve extra caution.

neptune.plainFocus: Confusion, surrender, uncertainty, porous boundaries, spirituality, art, secrecy, fog, fatigue, and quiet erosion.
examples: A situation becomes unclear, idealized, hidden, delayed, or hard to define.
Work, health, relationship, or money boundaries may blur unless the user asks direct questions.
Creative, spiritual, and compassionate openings are stronger when practical safeguards are present.

pluto.plainFocus: Power, pressure, control, exposure, obsession, survival patterns, buried material, and deep restructuring.
examples: A control dynamic, power struggle, financial entanglement, intense attachment, or hidden issue surfaces.
A role, relationship, habit, or system may need deep restructuring rather than cosmetic adjustment.
When practical indicators agree, the event can involve institutions, shared resources, therapy, investigation, or crisis management.

houseEventExamples.1: Body, identity, appearance, autonomy, personal launch, self-direction, and how the user meets the world.
houseEventExamples.2: Income, cash flow, possessions, pricing, debt prevention, earning strategy, spending patterns, and self-worth.
houseEventExamples.3: Messages, siblings, neighbors, paperwork, short travel, commuting, school, scheduling, devices, and daily logistics.
houseEventExamples.4: Home, family, parents, property, living situation, privacy, roots, moving, renovation, and emotional foundation.
houseEventExamples.5: Children, dating, creativity, pleasure, pregnancy-related topics, artistic risks, play, and personal joy.
houseEventExamples.6: Workload, coworkers, service, routines, health maintenance, appointments, recovery, burnout, daily systems, illness, injury, and the health affliction itself.
houseEventExamples.7: Marriage, partnership, clients, open conflict, contracts, negotiations, commitment talks, and relationship definition.
houseEventExamples.8: Shared money, taxes, debt, loans, inheritance, intimacy, trust, therapy, crisis support, and power exchange.
houseEventExamples.9: Law, higher education, teaching, publishing, long-distance travel, immigration, faith, worldview, and formal learning.
houseEventExamples.10: Career, reputation, public role, bosses, parents, achievement, leadership, visibility, and long-term contribution.
houseEventExamples.11: Friends, networks, audience, groups, community, collaborators, future plans, and collective commitments.
houseEventExamples.12: Rest, retreat, hidden matters, closure, hospitalization or institutional settings, quarantine, isolation, confinement, therapy, spiritual practice, and private burdens.

relationshipDefinition.plainMeaning: A relationship, client bond, legal agreement, or partnership status needs definition.
lookFor: 7th house or 7th ruler activated
Venus, Moon, Saturn, or Mars repeating the same relationship theme
Return chart emphasis on the 7th house or relationship planets
A fast trigger from Moon, Mercury, Venus, Mars, or Sun timing the conversation or decision

careerConsequence.plainMeaning: Work, visibility, responsibility, leadership, or reputation becomes concrete.
lookFor: 10th house, MC, 10th ruler, Sun, Saturn, or Jupiter activated
Return planet angular or connected to the 10th
Progressed Sun, Moon, Saturn, or chart ruler repeating the career topic
Mercury or Sun timing an announcement, meeting, interview, or public result

homeAndRelocation.plainMeaning: The living situation, family structure, property, or sense of roots becomes active.
lookFor: 4th house, IC, 4th ruler, Moon, Mars, Saturn, or Uranus activated
3rd/4th/9th house repetition for movement or relocation
Return chart angular Moon, Mars, Saturn, Uranus, or 4th ruler
Mercury or Moon timing paperwork, calls, showings, travel, or family conversations

healthMaintenanceAndBodyStress.plainMeaning: The body, workload, stress level, or care routines need attention.
lookFor: 1st, 6th, or 12th house activated
Sun, Moon, Mars, Saturn, Neptune, or chart ruler under repeated stress
Return chart emphasis on health houses or angular Mars/Saturn
Fast triggers timing appointments, symptoms, recovery decisions, or workload changes

legalEducationAndDocuments.plainMeaning: Formal paperwork, legal process, school, publishing, certification, travel, or institutional approval is active.
lookFor: 3rd, 7th, or 9th house activated
Mercury, Jupiter, Saturn, or the relevant house ruler emphasized
Return chart repetition of documents, law, education, travel, or institutional settings
Mercury timing the message, filing, signature, result, or appointment

moneyAndSharedResources.plainMeaning: Personal income, debt, shared money, taxes, loans, assets, or financial boundaries become active.
lookFor: 2nd or 8th house activated
Venus, Jupiter, Saturn, Mars, Pluto, or financial house rulers emphasized
Return chart repetition of money houses
Mercury, Venus, Mars, or Moon timing a payment, bill, agreement, dispute, or purchase

suddenBreakOrCourseCorrection.plainMeaning: A plan changes quickly because the current structure cannot hold the user's need for freedom, truth, or adaptation.
lookFor: Uranus, Mars, Mercury, angles, or mutable/cardinal house topics activated
Return chart emphasis on Uranus or a fast planet on an angle
Progressed Moon or chart ruler contacting Uranus, Mars, or Mercury
Fast trigger timing the call, disruption, accident-prone moment, technical problem, or sudden decision

spiritualOrPrivateRetreat.plainMeaning: The user may need quiet, closure, spiritual practice, therapy, recovery, grief support, or a private container.
lookFor: 12th house, Neptune, Saturn, Moon, South Node, or progressed balsamic/New phase themes activated
Return chart emphasis on hidden houses or retreat settings
Progressed Moon phase transition repeating the closure theme
Fast triggers timing withdrawal, rest, therapy, journaling, or a private conversation

firstReturn: Changing jobs because the old path was built around other people's expectations.
Defining a relationship instead of letting ambiguity carry the weight.
Facing debt, undercharging, unstable work, or money avoidance with a real plan.
Separating inherited authority from inner authority.
Choosing a long-term craft, credential, business, or vocation and accepting the repetition it requires.
Building boundaries with family, bosses, institutions, or partners.
secondReturn: Revising the meaning of usefulness, work, health, aging, and legacy.
Moving from proving competence into mentoring, teaching, simplifying, or building something that outlasts the user.
Choosing a next vocation or retirement structure based on truth instead of social expectation.
Taking the body seriously as a partner in the next chapter.
Letting completed responsibilities become complete instead of carrying them out of habit.
retrogradeReturn: Retrograde pass reviews why the old structure exists.
Final pass asks for a decision, commitment, or real-world adjustment.

prohibitions: Do not predict a specific event from one transit.
Do not use these examples to diagnose health conditions.
Do not present legal, pregnancy, custody, safety, financial, or relationship outcomes as guaranteed.
Do not use fear-based language to force urgency.
Do not expose source names or book titles in user-facing text.
weighting: Use examples only when repeated testimony supports them.
Angular contacts and activated rulers carry more weight than background aspects.
Progressions describe the life chapter; transits describe timing pressure.
Return charts describe the field for the year, month, or planetary cycle.
Fast planets can time the day, message, meeting, or decision only when a larger pattern is already active.
The same planet pair repeating across natal, progressed, return, and transit layers should be weighted up.
